test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

To get wind of
solution:
The correct answer is **To learn something secret**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **To get wind of:** begin to suspect that (something) is happening; hear a rumour of.

 
 
• **Example: **Ritu does not want her colleagues **to get wind of **her joining a new organization. 
 
 
 
• Thus, the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom is **To learn something secret.** 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
